checkbox.boundary: Real automation form and saved selections; disabled and mixed states are temporary DOM probes. Forced colors are emulated, not physical OS accessibility evidence.

scope: Actual task UI, real timed execution/provider HTTP/cancellation, engine permissions/context/usage, pause/resume/calendar, failure/retry, close/restart and complete native backup. Backup dialog boundaries use isolated fixtures; real cloud accounts, operating-system toast delivery, abrupt process termination and maximum-scale performance remain separate gates.
